raw_segments.text: Wait, dear. I haven't told you the chief, the final decision I came to during the night.
I feel that perhaps my decision is a terrible one for me, but I foresee that nothing will
induce me to change it, nothing. It will be so all my life. My dear, kind, ever-faithful
and generous advisor, the one friend I have in the world, Ivan Fyodorovich, with his deep
insight into the heart, approves and commends my decision. He knows it."
